name: Vault Custodian
description: The lower vault still recognizes this brass construct as its only keyholder. It turns its entire torso to drive a heavy lock-shaped fist forward.

abilities.description: Destroys up to 3 player block before striking.
Starts combat with 6 block. Absorbed damage spends it permanently for this fight.
